g.text: Reads the object buffer (no actual culling logic here - this is a
diagram skeleton) and emits one mesh-launch record per thread group for
Graph entry point: hands a single dispatch record to CullNode.
Mesh-launch node: rasterizes up to 64 triangles per thread group.
t<NR> := SRV (shader resource view) - read-only buffer/texture
u<NR> := UAV (unordered access view) - read-write buffer/texture
b<NR> := CBV (constant buffer view) - small constant-buffer data
Dashed border = grid can expand to >1 thread group per invocation
exactly one group (NodeDispatchGrid(1,1,1), thread launch, or coalescing)
A dashed edge from a global resource box into a node means that node reads it -
a global is effectively an input too, just dashed to stay visually distinct from
a produced-record edge; each global is replicated once per consuming node-group
to keep edges short (see the global resource table above for the full, ungrouped list)
